（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

319
11/5/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.

9th May 1918.

Sir,

Choch Yung Kwaung, the Tutuh of Chekiang
who became Chiangchun when that province declared
independence, resigned from his post a few days ago.
Choch visited General Yang at the Arsenal yesterday.
It is reported that the Central Government has
instructed General Yang to prepare a report regarding
the number of rebels here and the names of their leaders.
The Zauchow Guild has sent a representative to
the China Merchants Steam Navigation Co to warn them
against transporting Northern troops to the south
under any pretext whatever.

Your Obedient Servant,
Wbnew plcr hi
for
Chief Detective Inspector.

K
9
5.

Captain Superintendent.

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探股）

319
16年5月11日。
致上海工部局。

1918年5月9日。

先生：

浙江都督朱瑞（Choch Yung Kwaung），在该省宣布独立时改称将军者，已于数日前辞职。朱氏昨日前往兵工厂拜访杨将军。据报，中央政府已指令杨将军就本地叛军人数及其首领姓名准备一份报告。潮州会馆已派代表前往轮船招商局，警告该局不得以任何借口运送北军南下。

您顺从的仆人，
Wbnew plcr hi（原文不清）
代
总巡捕房探长。

K
9
5.

警务处处长。
